name: PolyPresence
description: PolyPresence is a production web app used at Polytech Lyon to centralize apprenticeship attendance and simplify signature workflows for students and staff.

name: DungeonCrawler
description: DungeonCrawler is a roguelike game created with the Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Graphics in C#. The goal of this project is to learn how to use C#.

name: CineTour
description: CineTour helps users discover movie shooting locations and nearby points of interest to build a thematic trip with an interactive map experience.

name: SudokuSolver
description: SudokuSolver is a Sudoku solver created with Java. It uses the backtracking algorithm and WFC algorithm to solve the Sudoku. It also has a graphical and terminal interface. You can save and load Sudoku from a file.

name: TP_OS_IIS
description: TP_OS_IIS is a project that aims to create a website with IIS and PHP to manage users of the OU on a Windows VM. This project was carried out as part of the UE OS.

name: 8T

name: Connect4IA
description: Connect4IA is a Connect 4 project combining MinMax, AlphaBeta and MCTS strategies, with a Python UI and a robotic arm integration for physical gameplay.

name: OnePieceWiki

name: FlashCardApp
description: FlashCardApp is a web application that allows you to create flashcards to learn vocabulary words. This project aims to teach the basics of Java.

name: JavaChess
description: JavaChess is a simple chess application in Java. This project aims to teach the basics of Java.

name: Dino-Runner

name: Chess Game with Random AI

name: Tetris

description: This is a basic calculator project created using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The goal of this project is to provide hands-on experience to learn and practice JavaScript.
